title: 第13章 测灵根第14章 半仙之体
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
轰隆！
雷从天降。
而紫色的弧光之下，小小孩童的身影坐得稳稳当当。
他不断在体内运行引雷诀的法诀要领，将无法吸收的狂暴能量排出体外，再将其余的能量吸收。
一遍又一遍。
直到，一丝微弱的雷光缠绕上孩童稚嫩的双臂。
他的身体也发出一阵不堪重负的哀鸣。
眼看天空的雷云还在酝酿，朔衡睁开眼睛，扭了扭浑身舒爽的肌肉，一个翻身跃下巨石。
此时，他的双臂电弧超绕，额间的印记也亮得发烫。
朔衡气沉丹田，挥出一掌。
轰——
一击，直接把硕大的巨石崩碎了三分之一。
“还挺有效果的嘛。”朔衡满意的捏了捏自己的拳头。
下一秒，男孩捂着嘴打了个哈欠。
没办法，他才一岁，还是嗜睡的年纪。
“唔……回去睡觉……！！”
不转身不知道，一转身吓一跳。
洺万里不知何时已经站在了他的身后，此刻正用一双看不出神色的眼睛盯着他。
“师父，这大下雨天的怎么还把您给惊动了？”朔衡半点儿不带心虚的，双手抱胸看向这个面色严肃的老头。
“你小子……”

洺万里本想问些什么，最后却只暗自叹了口气，作罢了。
无论朔衡拥有什么秘密，只要他不做出突破底线的行为，洺万里并不想太过管束他。
毕竟他知道，朔衡是个有主意的。
别看他才一岁，懂得东西却不一定比成年人少。
朔衡看着洺万里的神色，心头微动。
其实他不介意跟洺万里分享一下他得到的两个武技，毕竟，系统是个只负责卖不负责售后服务的‘小废物’。
没人看着他练功，他一个初入修仙界的小喽喽，心里还真是有点儿没底。
万一练功练岔了咋整？
于是，朔衡也不犹豫，直接拿出来两个武技递给洺万里。
“师父，您帮我掌掌眼啊？”
“哼，现在倒是想起来老夫了。”洺万里哼笑一声，到底还是拿起了两个卷轴。
除了引雷诀，另一个武技也是朔衡细心挑选的。
劲风之章，玄阶中品武技。
别看品阶不高，但效果却很好。
与追月剑法类似，劲风之章是一套掌法。
强身健体，能让人掌握自身体内所蕴含的力量，并且提升风系灵气的感应力。
看到这两本武技，洺万里也不得不感慨一句——朔衡年纪小小，眼光却毒辣得很。
content_en:
Boom!
Thunder fell from the sky.
Under the purple arc light, the figure of the little child sat firmly.
He constantly runs the key points of the Thunder-inducing Technique in his body, expelling the violent energy that cannot be absorbed from his body, and then absorbs the rest of the energy.
Over and over again.
Until, a faint ray of lightning wrapped around the child's tender arms.
His body also let out an overwhelmed whine.
Seeing the thunderclouds still brewing in the sky, Shuo Heng opened his eyes, twisted his muscles all over his body, turned over and jumped off the boulder.
At this time, the arcs of electricity in his arms were super-wrapped, and the mark on his forehead was also bright and hot.
Shuo Heng's anger sank into his dantian and he waved a palm.
Boom——
One blow directly shattered a third of the huge boulder.
"It's quite effective." Shuo Heng squeezed his fist with satisfaction.
The next second, the boy covered his mouth and yawned.
There is no way, he is only one year old and is still a sleepy age.
"Well...go back to sleep...!!"
If you don't turn around, you won't know. If you turn around, you'll be shocked.
Ming Wanli had already stood behind him at some point, staring at him with a pair of expressionless eyes.
"Master, why is it that this rainy day has alarmed you?" Shuo Heng looked at the serious-faced old man with his hands folded without any guilt.
"You kid..."
Ming Wanli wanted to ask something, but in the end he just sighed secretly and gave up.
No matter what secrets Shuo Heng has, as long as he doesn't do anything that breaks the bottom line, Ming Wanli doesn't want to control him too much.
After all, he knew that Shuo Heng had an idea.
Even though he is only one year old, he does not necessarily know less than adults.
Shuo Heng looked at Ming Wanli's expression and his heart moved slightly.
In fact, he doesn't mind sharing the two martial arts skills he got with Ming Wanli. After all, the system is a 'little waste' that only sells and does not provide after-sales service.
No one watched him practice. He was a newbie in the world of cultivating immortals, so he felt a little unsure.
What should I do if my practice goes wrong?
Therefore, Shuo Heng did not hesitate and directly took out two martial arts skills and handed them to Ming Wanli.
"Master, can you help me control my eyes?"
"Humph, I'm reminded of you now." Ming Wanli chuckled, and finally picked up the two scrolls.
In addition to the Thunder Drawing Technique, another martial art was also carefully selected by Shuo Heng.
The Chapter of Strong Wind, a mid-level Xuan-level martial arts skill.
Although the quality is not high, the effect is very good.
Similar to Chasing the Moon Sword Technique, Chapter of Strong Wind is a set of palm techniques.
Strengthening the body allows people to master the power contained in their own bodies and improve their sensitivity to wind aura.
After seeing these two martial arts books, Ming Wanli had to sigh with emotion - Shuo Heng was young but had a very vicious vision.
